summary: PVR Inox expands Soul Space Spirit with three new auditoriums, including a 4DX screen. The cinema now has seven screens and 1,143 seats in Bellandur.

headline: RO Jewels appoints Madhav Upadhyay as secretarial auditor
summary: RO Jewels Ltd board approves M/s Madhav Upadhyay and Associates as Secretarial Auditor for FY26. The firm is also recommended for re-appointment for five years from FY27 to FY31, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Sanghvi Brands sets AGM book closure dates
summary: Sanghvi Brands Limited has announced the book closure period for its 16th Annual General Meeting. The register of members will remain closed from September 12 to September 18, 2026.

headline: Dam Capital Advisors declares ₹1 dividend for FY26
summary: Dam Capital Advisors Limited declared a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share for FY26 at its 33rd AGM held on September 8, 2026. The meeting also approved the reappointment of MD & CEO Dharmesh Mehta and regularized Dhvanil Dharia as Whole Time Director.

headline: Anthem Biosciences settles upside sharing arrangement
summary: Anthem Biosciences Ltd has settled an upside sharing arrangement of ₹1,276.83 million with principal shareholders following the divestment by Viridity Tone LLP, as approved by public shareholders.

headline: TCC Concept Ltd confirms 1:5 share split credit
summary: TCC Concept Limited has confirmed the credit of sub-divided shares to depositories following a 1:5 split. The new face value is ₹2 per share, effective September 5, 2026.

headline: Gallard Steel files FY26 annual report, AGM notice
summary: Gallard Steel Limited has filed its 11th annual report for FY26 with the BSE. The company also issued a notice for its AGM, scheduled for September 30, 2026, to be held via video conferencing.

headline: Calcom Vision AGM: MD remuneration, cost audit
summary: Calcom Vision Ltd schedules its 41st AGM for September 30, 2026. Key agenda items include ratifying cost auditor fees and fixing the Managing Director's remuneration for a two-year term.

headline: Mishra Dhatu Nigam files FY26 BRSR with BSE, NSE
summary: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY26 to stock exchanges on September 8, 2026. The filing complies with SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Garware Technical Fibres AGM results
summary: Garware Technical Fibres shareholders approved FY26 financials and dividends at its 49th AGM. The company declared a final dividend of ₹1 per share. All resolutions passed.

headline: Mini Diamonds submits FY26 annual report to BSE
summary: Mini Diamonds (India) Ltd has submitted its 39th annual report for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, to the BSE. The filing complies with SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Country Club Hospitality AGM set for Sep 30, 2026
summary: Country Club Hospitality & Holidays Ltd has scheduled its 35th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The meeting will be held via video conferencing. E-voting opens on September 27 and closes on September 29.

headline: Olympic Cards AGM voting results filed
summary: Olympic Cards Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report for its 34th Annual General Meeting held on September 7, 2026. The filing confirms the completion of remote e-voting and video conferencing proceedings as per SEBI regulations.

headline: Octaware Technologies accepts resignation of independent director
summary: Octaware Technologies Ltd has accepted the resignation of Ms Vidya Hemakar Shetty as Independent Director, effective September 7, 2026. The departure is attributed to pre-occupation with other professional assignments.

headline: TCC Concept AGM: Office Shift, Director Re-appointment
summary: TCC Concept Limited schedules its 41st AGM for September 30, 2026. Key agenda items include shifting the registered office to Hinjewadi and re-appointing Mr. Abhishek Narbaria as a non-executive director.

headline: Onemi Technology Solutions to host investor meet on Sep 11
summary: Onemi Technology Solutions Ltd will hold non-deal roadshows with institutional investors on September 11, 2026. The company confirmed the schedule via a regulatory filing, noting discussions will rely on public information.

headline: SBI Cards to host investor meet on Sep 15
summary: SBI Cards & Payment Services Ltd will hold a group investor meeting with Jefferies on September 15, 2026, in Gurugram. The session is scheduled for 11:30 am and will be conducted in person.

headline: Affordable Robotic AGM: New ESOP scheme
summary: Affordable Robotic & Automation Ltd schedules its 17th AGM for September 30, 2026. Key agenda items include terminating the 2021 ESOP and approving a new 2026 scheme for 1.5 lakh options.

headline: 3C IT Solutions AGM: Board pay hikes approved
summary: 3C IT Solutions & Telecoms schedules its 11th AGM for September 30, 2026. Shareholders will vote on remuneration revisions for the MD and CFO, alongside director re-appointments. FY26 revenue rose 60% to ₹5,847.3 lakh.

headline: Golkonda Aluminium appoints secretarial auditor
summary: Golkonda Aluminium Extrusions Ltd board approved the appointment of M/s Parul Agrawal & Associates as secretarial auditor. The move requires shareholder ratification at the upcoming AGM.

headline: Juniper Green Energy adds 6.25 MW wind capacity
summary: Juniper Green Energy commissions 6.25 MW wind capacity via subsidiary, raising aggregate operational capacity to ~2,594 MWp and ~500 MWh BESS as of September 8, 2026.

headline: Cantabil Retail declares ₹0.75 final dividend
summary: Cantabil Retail India Ltd held its 38th AGM on September 8, 2026. Shareholders approved a final dividend of ₹0.75 per share and reappointed key directors including Vijay Bansal.

headline: PTC Industries files FY26 BRSR report
summary: PTC Industries submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY26 to stock exchanges. The filing details ESG metrics, including energy usage, waste management, and employee safety records.

headline: Aerpace Industries appoints Madhur Jajoo as independent director
summary: Aerpace Industries has appointed Madhur Sanjay Jajoo as an additional independent director effective September 9, 2026. The five-year term is subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Kemistar declares ₹0.20 final dividend
summary: Kemistar Corporation has fixed September 23, 2026 as the record date for its final dividend of ₹0.20 per share for FY26. The payout is subject to AGM approval.

headline: Filatex Fashions approves Seychelles subsidiary, new JMD
summary: Filatex Fashions board approved a Seychelles subsidiary for global expansion and appointed Rutvikbhai Beladiya as Joint Managing Director. The AGM is set for September 30, 2026.

headline: IMFA appoints Partha Satpathy as independent director
summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd has appointed former diplomat Partha Satpathy as an independent director. The appointment is effective from September 8, 2026, for a three-year term pending shareholder approval.

headline: Shalimar Productions AGM Book Closure Dates
summary: Shalimar Productions Ltd announces book closure from September 24 to 30, 2026 for its 41st Annual General Meeting.

headline: Sun Retail to approve FY26 annual report at AGM
summary: Sun Retail Limited will present its annual report for financial year 2025-2026 for approval at its 19th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 30, 2026.

headline: Primo Chemicals files FY26 BRSR report
summary: Primo Chemicals Limited has submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY26. The filing details energy consumption, water usage, and waste management metrics alongside CSR initiatives.

headline: Vruddhi Engineering AGM set for Sep 30, 2026
summary: Vruddhi Engineering Works Ltd has scheduled its annual general meeting for September 30, 2026. The event will be held at the company's registered office in Mumbai. Shareholders can access the annual report online.

headline: NMDC appoints M C Bhandari & Co as statutory auditor
summary: NMDC Ltd has appointed M/s. M C Bhandari & Co. as its statutory auditor for consolidated and standalone accounts, along with three firms for branch audits, effective September 8, 2026.
